patterns.note: A persistent, fixed header area containing the main hero statement and global navigation remains visible at the top, while all primary content scrolls underneath.
Project showcases are presented in a dynamic, asymmetrical grid of images that adapts to available space, creating visual interest without strict uniformity.
The site uses a strong typographic hierarchy with very large, bold sans-serif headings for the hero and project titles, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and minimal uppercase labels.
The UI is almost exclusively monochromatic, relying on stark black and white for backgrounds and text, allowing the vibrant project imagery to provide the only bursts of color.

The hero text 'Branding built for founders.' and the top-right navigation links ('Inquire', 'Information', 'Playground') along with the 'Oleg Coada' logo/name are sticky, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport as the page content scrolls beneath them.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header effect where the main hero statement and global navigation elements are fixed to the top of the viewport, allowing the primary content (project grid and testimonials) to scroll beneath them. This provides constant access to key information and reinforces the brand message.
Content sections are visually separated by large expanses of whitespace and distinct content blocks, rather than relying on background color changes or dividers.
Project images are displayed within a flexible grid system that allows for varying aspect ratios and sizes, creating a dynamic and visually engaging portfolio layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) for hero and project titles, with smaller, legible body text and very small uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous padding around content blocks and significant whitespace, especially in the hero and testimonial sections.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism and confidence, treating the hero text as a fixed, ever-present brand statement. It eschews typical marketing elements like prominent CTAs, instead letting the diverse, image-heavy project work speak for itself through a dynamic, asymmetrical grid, creating a highly focused and sophisticated portfolio experience.
